description: IndiaMART InterMESH Limited operates an online business-to-business (B2B) marketplace for business products and services in India and internationally. The company provides an online marketplace that enables listings and discovery of businesses, products, and services; buyer-supplier matchmaking; product search and discovery; request for quotation and BuyLead services; CRM Lead Manager; web storefront solutions; cloud telephony and Premium Number Service (PNS); AI-driven matchmaking; conversational commerce; multimodal search; product specifications and price discovery tools; reviews and ratings services; business enablement software; accounting solutions; and logistics SaaS solutions. The company also offers BUSY accounting software, including financial accounting, inventory management, billing and e-invoicing, GST compliance, taxation, analytics and reporting, production and job work, e-way bill, and scheme management solutions; Livekeeping, a mobile and web-based accounting platform; and credit facilitation, logistics and tracking, inventory management, distributor management, HRMS, procurement management, order management, compliance, and receivables management solutions. In addition, it operates IIL Digital, a digital marketplace for connecting business users with providers of credit facilities. IndiaMART InterMESH Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Noida, India.
